brief:
Jerusalem's electricity company announced a scheduled power outage affecting multiple neighborhoods in Jericho governorate on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, the Maan Wire reported. The blackout will run from 6:30 a.m. until 11 a.m., impacting residents across Sabihah district and portions of Qassab district.

The utility company said the cuts are required for necessary maintenance operations in the region. Residents in the affected areas were advised to prepare for the five-and-a-half-hour service interruption during the morning hours.
